name: Phoenix Disciple
body:
Virtuous mortals who dedicate themselves to good and fire magic and try to emulate the mighty firebirds can be accepted as phoenix disciples.

Requirements

To qualify to become a phoenix disciple, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Race: Any non-phoenix.
Alignment: Any good.
Skills: Knowledge (arcana) 5 ranks.
Languages: Celestial or Ignan.
Spellcasting: Able to cast burning hands. A sorcerer or bloodrager with this prestige class must have the phoenix bloodline. If the character gains levels of sorcerer or bloodrager after taking this class, she must take the phoenix bloodline.
Class Skills

The phoenix disciple’s class skills are Acrobatics (Dex), Diplomacy (Cha), Fly (Dex), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (arcana, nature, planes) +26, Perception (Wis), Sense Motive (Wis), and Spellcraft (Int).

Skill Ranks at Each Level: 2 + Int modifier.

Hit Die: d10.

Table: Phoenix Disciple
Level	Base Attack Bonus	Fort Save	Ref Save	Will Save	Special	Spells per Day
1st	+0	+1	+1	+0	Blood of the phoenix, natural armor increase +1	—
2nd	+1	+1	+1	+1	Ability boost (Con +2), bloodline feat	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
3rd	+2	+2	+2	+1	Phoenix flames	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
4th	+3	+2	+2	+1	Ability boost (Con +2), natural armor increase +2	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
5th	+3	+3	+3	+2	Bloodline feat, darkvision 30 ft., phoenix glory (1/day)	—
6th	+4	+3	+3	+2	Ability boost (Str +2)	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
7th	+5	+4	+4	+2	Phoenix glory (2/day), natural armor increase +3	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
8th	+6	+4	+4	+3	Ability boost (Cha +2), bloodline feat	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
9th	+6	+5	+5	+3	Phoenix wings	—
10th	+7	+5	+5	+3	Phoenix glory (3/day), darkvision 60 ft., phoenix rebirth	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
Class Features

All of the following are class features of the phoenix disciple prestige class.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

Phoenix disciples gain no proficiency with any weapon or armor.

Spells per Day

At the indicated levels, a phoenix disciple gains new spells per day as if she had also gained a level in a spellcasting class she belonged to before adding the prestige class. She does not, however, gain other benefits a character of that class would have gained, except for additional spells per day, spells known (if she is a spontaneous spellcaster), and an increased effective level of spellcasting. If a character had more than one spellcasting class before becoming a phoenix disciple, she must decide to which class she adds the new level for purposes of determining spells per day.

Blood of the Phoenix

A phoenix disciple adds her level to her sorcerer or bloodrager levels when determining the powers gained from her bloodline. A character with levels in both bloodrager and sorcerer must choose which class stacks with her phoenix disciple levels to determine her bloodline powers. If she does not have levels in sorcerer or bloodrager, she instead gains bloodline powers of the phoenix sorcerer bloodline, using her phoenix disciple level as her sorcerer level to determine the bonuses gained. This ability does not grant bonus spells to a sorcerer or bloodrager unless she possesses spell slots of an appropriate level. Such bonus spells are automatically granted if the sorcerer or bloodrager gains spell slots of the spell’s level.

Natural Armor Increase (Ex)

At 1st, 4th, and 7th level, a phoenix disciple gains a magical protection from attacks, causing a cumulative increase to her natural armor bonus of +1.

Ability Boost

As her body slowly acquires the properties of a phoenix’s red-gold plumage, a phoenix disciple gains stat boosts as noted on Table 16: Phoenix Disciple. These increases stack and are gained as if through level advancement.

Bloodline Feat

Upon reaching 2nd level, and every three levels thereafter, a phoenix disciple receives one bonus feat, chosen from the sorcerer phoenix bloodline’s bonus feat list or from the bloodrager phoenix bloodline’s bonus feat list, depending on which one she is advancing with her level progression.

Phoenix Flames (Sp)

At 3rd level, the phoenix disciple can cast healing flames once per day as a spell-like ability. She gains an additional use of this ability per day for every 3 levels beyond 3rd.

Darkvision (Ex)

At 5th level, the phoenix disciple gains darkvision with a range of 30 feet. If she already possessed darkvision, the ability range increases by 30 feet instead. At 10th level, the phoenix disciple adds another 30 feet to her darkvision range.

Phoenix Glory (Sp)

At 5th level, the phoenix disciple is able to assume the form of a Medium-sized phoenix once per day, as beast shape III. At 7th level, she can become a Large phoenix as beast shape IV, and this ability can be used twice per day; at 10th level, the phoenix disciple can assume the form of a Huge phoenix as magical beast shape three times per day.

Phoenix Wings (Su)

At 9th level, the phoenix disciple gains the molten wings ability of the sorcerer phoenix bloodline or the vermilion wings ability of the bloodrager phoenix bloodline (depending on which one she is advancing with her level progression), even if she doesn’t normally possess that power. Once her level is high enough to grant this ability through the bloodline, the phoenix disciple’s fly speed increases by 30 feet.

Phoenix Rebirth (Su)

At 10th level, the phoenix disciple gains the rebirth ability of the phoenix sorcerer bloodline, even if she doesn’t normally possess that power. If she already possesses rebirth through her bloodline, she is brought back to life 1 round after death rather than 1 minute.
